source_caption_text:
Nothing will ever recreate the feeling of hearing this “Miss the Rage” snippet

The feeling of hearing Trippie Redd’s “Miss the Rage” snippet for the first time was something else. The second those synths kicked in, you already knew the song was going to be crazy. It was one of those snippets you kept replaying because you couldn’t believe how good the beat sounded.

The hype around this was unreal. People were making edits, adding Playboi Carti vocals and begging for the song to drop before it was even officially out. Everybody wanted to hear the full version.

Looking back, it’s hard to explain just how much hype those first few seconds had. “Miss the Rage” had people hooked off the beat alone, and hearing that snippet for the first time is a memory that’s hard to recreate. 

#trippieredd #playboicarti #hiphop
